newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Montoro says Feb inflation will decline.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Montoro says Feb inflation will decline.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Tuesday February inflation would continue falling in year-on-year terms despite the truckers strike, according to local agencies.
"We expect February inflation will decline and prices will continue to follow a decelerating path," Montoro said, speaking in Barcelona.
In January, inflation fell to a 28-year low of 2.9 percent year-on-year.
He also said Spain "is one of the most serious candidates" for joining the common currency, since it is on the way to fulfilling Maastricht criteria on inflation, interest rates and public deficit.
